title: Podcast EP372: An Overview of Some Important New Sessions at Semicon West with Julie Rogers
gist: SemiWiki podcast episode with ESD Alliance Executive Director Julie Rogers previewing SEMICON West 2026 (October 13-15, Moscone Center, San Francisco) and its newly expanded full-day Design Session. The page offers little substance beyond the event outline.
